repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (using `if (diff < 0) { diff = t1 - t2 }`) before checking the threshold, whereas the IR strictly computes the signed difference `$t2 - $t1`. This causes the candidate to trigger on a temperature drop (negative change) when the IR only triggers on a rise of at least 3 degrees. Evidence F2 confirms the IR emitted no action while the JoI emitted one, indicating the condition logic is inverted relative to the IR's signed arithmetic.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value correction logic. The script now directly computes `t2 - t1` and checks if it is `>= 3`, preserving the IR's requirement for a positive temperature change of at least 3 degrees.
